import sys,random

    mon=M.build_monitor('contains',[si[t] for t in p],2)

        s=dq.pop()
        for c in range(2):
            t=tr[s][c]
            if t not in seen: seen.add(t); dq.append(t)
    print("natoms",natoms,"pat",''.join(p),"single reachable",len(seen),"n",len(tr))
  # product count
  atoms=[('contains',tuple(p)) for p in pats]
  try:
    rows,acc=M.build_product(atoms,si,2)
    print("   product states",len(rows))
